AFA] }} ==Relegation== Clubs with an indirect affiliation with [[Argentine Football Association]] are relegated to the [[Torneo Argentino A]], while clubs directly affiliated face relegation to [[Primera B Metropolitana]]. Clubs with direct affiliation are all from [[Greater Buenos Aires]], with the exception of [[Rosario Central]], [[Newell's Old Boys]], [[Central Córdoba de Rosario|Central Córdoba]] and [[Argentino de Rosario]], all from [[Rosario]], and [[Unión de Santa Fe|Unión]] and [[Colón de Santa Fe|Colón]] from [[Santa Fe, Argentina|Santa Fe]].
